## How tested
- [ ] Unit tests pass (CI "Build & test")
- [ ] Verified in the Simulator
- [ ] Verified on a device (for UI / behavior changes)

## Checklist
- [ ] Targets `develop` (feature/fix/chore/docs) — not `main`
- [ ] Branch rebased on the latest `develop`
- [ ] Conventional-commit title (`type(scope): summary`)
- [ ] One concern, focused change
